claims.text: The transmitted French bill proposes retaining Queen Ranavalo’s internal functions; it is not enactment. Malagasy Customs describes port supervision and coexisting services without a final absorption date. Laroche’s notice concerns American consular cases at Tamatave. These distinct witnesses do not establish instant uniform replacement, legitimate title or consent.

claims.text: Which local evidence defeats an instant all-institution replacement story? Customs coexistence and an unknown absorption date differ from a proposed royal arrangement and a specific consular-jurisdiction notice. Neither a bill nor a colonial notice establishes everyone’s actual administration.
